finding: uncertainty about your own blind spot is not a reason to observe less but to move differently: the hedged plan recovered 3 of 4 task events where a confidently wrong plan kept 1, at a cost of 1 event against an oracle. The hedge picks the opposite drift to the confident optimum.
limits: one world, one belief set (+/-20), one task time, one drift grid, noise-free; minimax hardening, not a decision-theoretic optimum. A Bayesian planner with a prior over the error is not claimed.
